name: Ade

attributes.attribute: second wife of Lancelot in some texts
Ade is his second wife after an unnamed first wife
does not become the lover of queen Guinevere in these texts

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: In some Arthurian texts, Ade is the second wife of Lancelot. Lancelot is a knight of the Round Table. His first wife is unnamed in these texts. In this version, Lancelot does not become the lover of queen Guinevere.

okr.objective: Describe Ade as the second wife of Lancelot in Arthurian tradition.
key_results: Names Ade as the second wife of Lancelot
States Lancelot does not love queen Guinevere in this version.
